summary.en: At IPCC-65 (12–16 Oct 2026, Addis Ababa) governments could not agree on when the three Working Group reports of the seventh assessment (AR7) should be approved, and the session was suspended.
summary.zh: IPCC第65屆全會（2026年10月12至16日，阿迪斯阿貝巴）上，各國無法就第七次評估報告（AR7）三份工作小組報告的審議時程達成共識，會議因此中止。
